findings.finding: Public admission remains unqualified for OS/container limits, TLS/ALPN/Cloudflare ingress, provider compatibility and trailer policy.
This transport permit authorizes private exact-byte capture only. Endpoint/account/mode/generation/secret authority, inbox/Oban atomicity and billing/G23 remain unqualified.

No supported telemetry API atomically prevents a privileged subscriber or raw IO. Bootstrap/reconfiguration must remain trusted; drift detection cannot undo prior delivery. Negative controls establish that limitation.

Keep dedicated-role sink bootstrap before listener start and retain schema filters through crash/teardown. The future trusted Plug must always dispose in an after/finally path; capture errors return halted connections while the independent deadline stays active.
Finite H2 hostile cases and burst submission demonstrate protected-profile behavior; they do not independently validate the dependency reset-rate threshold or sustained hostile-load ceilings.
